item.title: Lubbock Feeders announces feedyard closure after 70 years
item.description: It’s the end of an era on the South Plains. After 70 years of operation, Lubbock Feeders, a cornerstone of the region’s agricultural economy since 1955, has announced it will close its doors.

item.title: Texas Tech gets right with home rout of K-State
item.description: No. 13 Texas Tech stepped onto the court Saturday for the first time since their upset loss to Arizona State, where it also lost star JT Toppin to a season-ending injury. From start to end, they left no doubts to their ability to win without Toppin in a 100-72 rout of Kansas State at United Supermarkets Arena.
